steps.why: M. Thomas scored a goal for Azure City at minute 55, making the score 2-1 with a powerful 96 km/h shot.

steps.text: Gooooal! Thomas puts Azure City ahead 2-1 with a fierce shot!
¡Golazo de Thomas! ¡Azure City toma la ventaja 2-1 con un disparo feroz!

steps.why: The reaction to M. Thomas's goal is building the momentum after Azure City's lead at minute 55.

steps.text: Azure City roar with joy! Lima eyes the next big chance!
¡Azure City ruge de alegría! ¡Lima busca la próxima gran oportunidad!
